subject: Important Update: Meeting Schedule Change
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, we need to reschedule the upcoming team meeting from Friday to next Monday at 10:00 AM. Please make a note of this change in your calendars. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to me. Best regards, [Your Name]
